adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within the `updateAllCalendarEvents` catch block, the diff removes `console.error(message);` and replaces the return with a mapped `success: false` result array. The code still builds/updates `message` (including `message.replace(...)`) but does not emit it via `console`, `logger`, or `log.error` anywhere in that catch. So failures handled by this catch will now return failure results without any server-side logging from this block. This is a concrete, diff-grounded observability/regression concern, but it doesn’t by itself prove a functional correctness defect (the function still returns failure results).
